source_findings.claim: The active GRID design distinguishes R0 deterministic recursion, R1 recursive model calls, R2 recursive full harness children and R3 GRID-adaptive routing.
The donor carries Claude session identity and optional room session identity across a Realtime conversation.
Provider call_id is retained from a function_call through execution and function_call_output re-entry.
Presence-derived causal_event_id can flow into initiative episode logging.

The examined live Realtime source has no agent_id, parent_agent_id, task_id, recursive_call_id or generation fields. Therefore the minimum RAH child lineage required by the design is not implemented in this donor path.
Voice identity_version fingerprints persona/config state and is not recursive actor/task/effect lineage.

hypothesis.claim: Adaptive GRID routing among deterministic computation, recursive LM calls and recursive full harnesses can outperform a fixed recursion strategy on mixed workloads.
hypothesis.counterhypothesis: Router overhead and duplicated state management erase the gains; a simpler strong harness with bounded spawning is cheaper and more reliable.
hypothesis.falsifier: Matched-model fixed-budget mixed-workload ablation shows no verifier-adjusted gain or materially worse coordination/latency/cost for GRID-adaptive routing.
